czar:
n. a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917)
n. a person having great power
czarina: n. 沙皇皇后, 女沙皇
n. the wife or widow of a czar
czarist:
n. 沙皇追随者, 拥护独裁政治者
a. 沙皇的
a. of or relating to or characteristic of a czar
czech:
n. 捷克人, 捷克语
a. 捷克的, 捷克语的, 捷克人的

n. a native of inhabitant of the Czech Republic
n. the Slavic language of Czechs
a. of or relating to Czechoslovakia or its people or their language
czechoslovak:
n. 捷克斯洛伐克人
a. 捷克斯洛伐克的, 捷克斯洛伐克人的
n a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia
czechoslovakia: n. a former republic in central Europe; divided into Czech Republic and Slovakia in 1993
czechoslovakian: n. a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia
